title: One token selects a grammar rule
hook: One lookahead symbol must choose a production without guessing.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Prefix codes, strings, grammar productions and a stack.
doesNotKnow: Select a predictive-parse production from FIRST/FOLLOW and detect a conflicting table cell.

misconception: An empty production is valid only when the input is already exhausted.
objective: Select a predictive-parse production from FIRST/FOLLOW and detect a conflicting table cell.

claims.text: The table chooses A’s repeating production on b and its empty production on the end marker from FOLLOW(A). A lookahead cell with two productions is a conflict; this parser must reject the grammar as LL(1), rather than guess.
